sql.projectProcessStep.insertProjectProcessS: insert into flow.project_process_step(project_id, process_step_id, user_position_id, company_process_step_status_type_id, created_by_id) values (:projectId, :processStepId, :userPositionId, :statusTypeId, :createdById)
sql.projectProcessStep.getProjectProcessStep: select ps.id as process_step_id, pps.id as project_process_step_id, pps.project_id, pps.process_step_complete_date, coalesce(pps.date_modified, pps.date_created) as last_updated, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, ps.process_step_name, ( select row_to_json(o) from ( select u.id as "userId", u.first_name as "firstName", u.last_name as "lastName", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "fullName", p.position from blueraven.user u inner join flow.user_position up on up.user_id = u.id inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where up.id = pps.user_position_id ) o ) AS owner from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id where pps.id = :stepId

select a.id, a.size, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.filename, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.s3_key from flow.project_process_step_attachment ppsa inner join flow.attachment a on a.id = ppsa.attachment_id where ppsa.project_process_step_id = :projectProcessStepId
sql.projectProcessStep.setStatus: update flow.project_process_step set company_process_step_status_type_id = :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now(), process_step_complete_date = ( case when :processStepStatusTypeId = 2 then now() end) where id = :projectProcessStepId;
sql.projectProcessStep.updateOwner: update flow.project_process_step set user_position_id = :userPositionId, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :projectProcessStepId
